title: The project garden got easier to explore
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: more projects to discover, clearer attribution, and sturdier text-generation plumbing.

The project section was cleaned up and the Gacha bot joined the growing list of things people are building with pollinations.

Author links now use a new shared approach, making it easier to connect projects and contributions to their makers.

Server updates, more reliable tests and API handling, and a DRY refactor of text generation modules tightened the machinery behind text.pollinations.ai. Less duplicated code, fewer opportunities for software to develop opinions.
